name: inverting amplifier with a vcvs
description: An operational amplifier of gain A = 1e5 as a vcvs from the non-inverting input (gnd) and the inverting input m to the output, with R_in = 1 kohm and R_f = 10 kohm. The gain v_out / v_in is -(R_f / R_in) / (1 + (1 + R_f / R_in) / A) = -9.998900 at every instant: the vcvs acts within the time step, so the feedback through R_f is not one step late.
